verdict.rationale: The evidence describes separate API resources: balances, transactions, identity, payments and account details. It also mentions that end-users grant access to accounts. None of it documents developer-selectable product scopes, scoped consent screens in Teller Connect, or data-minimization controls. Separate endpoints and per-account authorization are adjacent features, not scoped-consent capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I request only the data scopes I need — product-scoped consents and documented data-minimization controls, not an all-or-nothing grant
